sources.summary: The world's most prominent architecture studios are embracing AI for everything from coming up with designs to project analyses and reports, Dezeen research has found. Twenty-six leading architecture studios from around the world told Dezeen about their use of artificial intelligence (AI), including SOM and Foster + Partners.
